approach_name: Mountaineers Route / North Fork of Lone Pine Creek
notes: Explicitly excluded from the Whitney Zone lottery by name on the Mt. Whitney permit page ("This permit does not include trips up North Fork of Lone Pine Creek trail..."). Inyo NF's Wilderness Trail Names and Quotas PDF lists it as its own line item (trail code JM34) with a separate 10/6/4 rolling-reservation quota, structurally distinct from the Whitney Zone's 100/100/0 lottery-only allocation.

data/sps_peaks.csv lists this peak's source trailhead as "Meysan Lake Trail", a separate use-trail from the classic Mt. Whitney Trail -- no source has been found directly confirming whether Inyo NF treats it as inside or outside the Whitney Zone lottery. Do not assume the Whitney Portal default applies without checking.
